overrides.value: A square glass perfume bottle with a gold cap stands on a white kitchen counter in the center of the frame and never leaves it; the camera is locked, no movement. Through the window behind the counter a white delivery truck drives slowly past, and this same bottle is printed huge on the truck's side panel, sunlight flashing on the panel. Traffic sounds.

cases.note: Truck Ad experiment A (enhance off, locked camera, truck in the background): in run 20261022-0358 the camera left the bottle for a truck. Result in run 20261023-222828-h100: fails: the bottle shrinks out of frame and the truck carries garbled letters.

overrides.value: The bottle stays in the center of the frame, in sharp focus, camera locked. A toy-sized white delivery truck drives into the frame along the counter, this exact bottle printed on its side panel, and parks beside the bottle. Soft toy engine sound.

cases.note: Truck Ad experiment B (enhance off, a toy truck comes to the bottle). Result in run 20261023-222828-h100: works: a toy truck with the bottle printed on it parks beside it; a hand pushes it for a moment. Became the template..

overrides.value: The bottle stands in the exact center of the frame on the counter and does not move at all for the whole shot; the camera is locked. Plain grey cardboard boxes slide in from the left and from the right, bump against the bottle and bounce away, tumbling out of the frame, while the bottle stays still and upright until the last frame. Cartoon whoosh and thud sounds.

cases.note: Kick Ad experiment A (enhance off, the bottle never moves): in run 20261022-0358 the box knocked the bottle out of frame. Result in run 20261023-222828-h100: works partly: blurry boxes slide past, the bottle never moves, no kick.

overrides.value: The bottle stays centered and upright on the counter; the camera is locked. Each plain grey box that slides toward it is flicked away by a short hop of the bottle, which lands back on the same spot; the boxes tumble off screen. The bottle is in the center of the frame until the last frame. Comedic whoosh and thud sounds.

cases.note: Kick Ad experiment B (enhance off, the bottle hops to kick). Result in run 20261023-222828-h100: works: boxes fly off around the bottle, which stays put. Became the template..

overrides.value: Locked-off shot, no camera movement. The bottle stays in the center of the frame, in sharp focus, for the entire clip. Behind it the white wall dissolves into an erupting volcano far in the distance: lava fountains, glowing ash drifting, heat shimmer, all out of focus; a red glow reflects on the glass. Deep rumble.

cases.note: Volcano Ad experiment A (enhance off, locked camera): in run 20261022-0358 the camera panned away to the volcano. Result in run 20261023-222828-h100: fails: the camera pans to the volcano and the bottle drops out.

overrides.value: The bottle stands on black volcanic rock in the center of the frame and stays there; a slow push-in toward the bottle only, never panning away. Far behind it a volcano erupts, lava and ash in the background, red glow on the glass. Deep rumbling.

cases.note: Volcano Ad experiment B (enhance off, push-in only). Result in run 20261023-222828-h100: fails: push-in on the bottle, no volcano at all. Volcano Ad moved to the morph base..

overrides.value: Locked wide shot of the oak tree on the hill; the tree stays in the frame. Behind it a giant humanoid creature made of dark storm cloud rises from the clouds on the horizon, with a head, shoulders and two arms, lightning flickering inside its body, towering over the tree; rain begins to fall.
